run_tfe_benchmarks_multiprocess: run the CrypTen TFEncrypted benchmarks in multiprocess mode with configurable world size and epochs
run_tfe_benchmarks_single_process: run the CrypTen TFEncrypted benchmarks in single process mode with default network B
run_tfe_benchmarks_with_aws: run the CrypTen TFEncrypted benchmarks on AWS EC2 instances using the aws_launcher script
run_tfe_benchmarks_evaluate: evaluate a trained CrypTen TFEncrypted model on the validation set using the evaluate flag
run_tfe_benchmarks_resume: resume CrypTen TFEncrypted benchmark training from a saved checkpoint path
